summary: The build is on track for Botswana (30 November to 3 December). Guests will register on your familiar Google Form, with one small addition so we can message them about their travel. Once you have your Botswana brief, we will prepare the form with you.

whats_next: After your Botswana briefing on Thursday: let Deon know the key dates, and we prepare the registration form with you before the link goes out
Weekend of 24 to 25 October: the new WhatsApp number goes onto your phone at Vodacom (your own number stays as it is)
Then we start the WhatsApp business approval

needs_from_you.why: So we can prepare the Botswana form for you

updates.text: Agreed: guests register for Botswana on your Google Form as usual, with one added tick box so they agree to receive WhatsApp and SMS messages about their travel. Deon will prepare the form for you. The new WhatsApp number goes onto your phone on the weekend of 24 to 25 October; nothing changes on your personal WhatsApp.

Received your iPad details, your company documents for the WhatsApp approval, your Cape Town shuttle list and the headings of your registration sheet. Thank you, this helps a great deal. For practice we will use a scrambled copy of the Cape Town list, so no real guest details are shared.
Cape Town dates received (14 to 19 November). We will use them for a quiet practice run alongside your own process.
Event dates received: Botswana, 30 November to 3 December, with accreditation on 1, 2 and 3 December. Logos received. Manual check-in by name, without a scan, is planned for the day.
Project approved. Planning complete and the build team is set up. Registration and event setup come first.

change_requests.title: Team photos in guest messages
change_requests.status: Noted for after the December event. In the meantime, messages will name the host (for example, "Your host today is Thandi").
